name: variables_and_links_in_one_step
why: BRIEF §5.1 (25/10/2026). On 24/10/2026 a part took five «global_variable» and six «link_dimension», eleven steps, each with its own evaluation and rebuild. «parameters» writes variables and links in one step: everything checked before anything is written, written in one go (the variables first, so that a link can use a variable of the same step), evaluated and rebuilt once, every value read back. The plate of «wall_has_a_name», driven the same way: 96000 -> 115200 -> 144000 mm3.
defect_caught: A link written before the variable it uses (SOLIDWORKS refuses it); a variable or a link that does not read back as asked; a refusal that leaves half of the equations written.

expect.why: an expression on a variable of the same step
the dimension re-read is worth as much as the equation
120 x 80 x 15: the linked thickness follows the variable
